messages:
zoe: Quick logistics question for folks running orientation tomorrow  the calendar shows 09:00 PT for the main session but weve got new hires across PT/CET/AEST. Is there a canonical replay link we should circulate after the call?
onboarding-bot: Event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-main-2024. Recording will be uploaded to the event and to Drive under /onboarding/live-recordings within 30 minutes of end.
raul: Hi @zoe  we also produce a trimmed 20-30 min "quick-watch" + full recording + captions. Links are in the event description once the uploader finishes. For immediate share use the meeting link: https://meet.google.com/abc-orient.
maya: Heads up  a few new hires in APAC reported their calendar converted 09:00 PT -> 02:00 local and duplicated the event. Any tips to avoid doubles in Outlook/Apple?
devon: This is usually from importing the .ics after already accepting the Google invite. Best practice: accept the Google invite only (don't import .ics), or if you must import the .ics, delete the Google invite first. I'll add a line in the description to avoid double-accept.
maya: Thanks. Can we get the slides and an agenda pointer in advance so managers can prep role-specific questions?
raul: Slides + agenda uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood/onboard/2024-orient. Agenda includes chapters with timestamps (e.g., Security @ 00:12:30, Infra @ 00:33:00) so folks can jump to sections in the trimmed video.
onboarding-bot: Uploaded captions (EN) and SRTs. Transcript will arrive in Notion: https://redwood.notion.so/onboarding/session-transcripts within an hour of upload.
zoe: Are breakout rooms planned for the icebreaker? A few hires said joining from mobile drops them into a waiting room sometimes.
devon: We'll do two 10-min breakout rooms. Mobile experience known issue: some clients force callers into a waiting room on breakout. We'll provide a backup: small group text channels post-call for the activity and the facilitator will paste prompts in chat.
maya: Also request from folks with accessibility needs: any chance of live ASL interpreter or translated captions for Spanish?
raul: We can add live ASL if requested in advance  please DM me names. For Spanish captions we enable auto-translate on the recording and attach the SRT when review quality passes. If a manager needs guaranteed translated captions, tell me and we'll schedule a dedicated session.
infra-bot: Note: created APAC-friendly replay event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-apac-2024 at 09:30 AEST on 2024-11-16; invited group new-hires@redwood.com.
zoe: One last sync  when the recording posts, who should I ping to get a short URL for the onboarding deck + recording bundle to paste into the offer packet?
raul: Ping @raul or DM me in Slack. I'll generate a short link and add it to the "New Hire Welcome" doc in Notion. Also filing a small ticket with infra if the .ics timezone metadata continues to cause duplicates.
maya: Perfect  thanks everyone. I'll circulate the short link once Raul posts it and remind managers to RSVP with new hires' start dates. :thumbsup:
zoe: Thanks  if anyone sees timezone weirdness after this thread, drop the event ID and your local TZ and @devon will produce a TZ-fixed .ics.
